system.summary: Homophonic substitution with graphic signs (about 60 signs for the Italian alphabet), no word division; family of signs differs between letters of the box.
system.notes: Dots distinguish sign variants; the 115 key sheets of the box are 19th-century reconstructions and none was matched.

prior_solution.where: No decipherment found in DECODE, Tomokiyo or the literature checked.

conditions.human_role: Project-level: the user set the goals, approved downloads (CTTS) and asked for the hand pass.

solution.what: Fetched all 174 cart. 1597 records from DECODE (115 key sheets, 59 ciphertexts).
Built a sign reader (deskew, line strips, connected components, dot attachment, Ward clustering) after the CTTS reader failed on these scans.
CTTS homophonic solver run headless on the sign tokens with period Italian, Latin and other corpora.
Shuffled-token runs and simulated Italian ciphers with 0, 8 and 15% sign noise: real/shuffled score ratio 1.65 for Italian against Latin 1.38, Spanish 1.36, French 1.32.
Word-guided key refinement, token pair rules and a hand correction pass on P1 and P2 lines 1-3; dictionary-word coverage rose 10.9% to 24.2%.
Only short stretches build Italian words (dele letere, gravisima, tornare, desiderio); no sentence-level reading.

Outside check of issue 492 (prabal-rje): their own keys for R5464 and R5465, found from the ciphertext alone on our sign tokens, were re-applied to the tokens; the shown-letter shares (86.4% of 3,249 signs; 68.0% of 5,828 signs) reproduce, and their R5464 letters equal our refined key's letters on 89.7% of the shown signs (they state 86.6% of all signs). The sense-reading by two blind language models (65-70% of shown letters for R5464) was not re-run; it is the contributor's figure and is not counted here.

PR 494 (prabal-rje): their keys and decodes for R5463, R5464 and R5465, in our sign labels, were re-applied to our tokens with own scripts. Shown shares reproduce (R5463 1,070 of 1,372 = 78.0%; R5464 2,808 of 3,249 = 86.4%; R5465 3,961 of 5,828 = 68.0%); R5464 shown letters equal our refined key's on 89.7% and their main key equals it on 86.6% of signs. For R5463 their key equals our refined key on only 48.8% of signs (55.7% of shown signs); their decode builds Italian words by eye where ours does not. The blind-reader sense figures, simulation accuracies and rival-hill figures are the contributor's and were not re-run. Not a reading by the read bar.

Contributor prabal-rje (pull request 825), his step by his own record: transcription of the DECODE images of 10 pages of 9 records, as sign labels local to each page (outside_prabal-rje_2026-11-19/transcription/).

Contributor prabal-rje (pull request 825), his step by his own record: a key from the cipher text alone for each page or group of pages (10 pages). Language models and own Python scripts; the models are not named at his request.

Contributor prabal-rje (pull request 825), his step by his own record: each key applied to its rows, sign by sign; his frozen reads kept apart. No reading in sentences: every document is decoded, not read.

Review of pull request 825 for the maintainers (an AI agent; no person re-checked it). Each key table applied to its rows with our own decoder: all 10 decodes of this folder equal his line for line (46 of 46 counting the 36 pages of cart. 1598 in targets/sforza1598). The 'Agree' figures of his check.md recount exactly: 5,925 of 6,590 letters shown in his frozen reads (24,483 of 27,152 for cart. 1598). Solver control of the first review (a plain hill-climbing solver on each page and on a shuffled copy of it; reported in the pull request, not run again for the fold): on R5445 p. 1, and on R5516 p. 1, R5564 p. 1 and R5583 p. 1 of cart. 1598, his key scores below what the solver reaches on the shuffled signs, so nothing in the folder confirms those four keys; he marked them 'key not confirmed'. R5445: his answer that its key table takes its values from his frozen read, which by his record gives the firm letters of the decode with his key of R5516, R5519 and R5522, agrees with the files and with his public page of 19 Nov 2026. The rows were not compared with the DECODE images.

outcome.method_basis: Language is Italian (controls), but the sign reader and 60-homophone key give only 24% dictionary-word coverage; no sentences build.
outcome.notes: Image resolution (15-25 px signs) is the limit; the unsent request to ASMi asks for 400 dpi images of leaves 158-159 and 164-165. outcome.parts lists only the pages contributed by prabal-rje (pull request 825, folded in on 20 Nov 2026), one part for each catalogue entry, all decoded, not read; outcome.method and method_basis describe the project's own work.
